meaning:
A prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ch.9.29
Another spelling of id.do (עִדּוֹ "Iddo" H5714I)
§ Iddo = "appointed"
the seer who proclaimed to king Jeroboam of Israel
